## Body

| 1 | ⚪ LOW | crates/tmux/src/lib.rs | 1129-1142 | Manual repair omits configured tmux server selection; copying it can target the default server instead | 10/10 |

This is a nonblocking repair-targeting note, not a demonstrated injection vulnerability. Select the configured server before manual use; ideally the printed command should carry its server selector.

## Ownership and rollback

The adapter derives the expected sink and requires exact sink equality. An existing pipe needs an exact matching pane-scoped `@pij-tap-sink` marker, including for a tracked pane. Missing or mismatched markers refuse before stamping, sink creation or replacement (`crates/tmux/src/lib.rs:1089-1209`). Removing the legacy census removes an adoption exception rather than accepting foreign pipes.

Failed replacement preserves a marker only when it matched before this attempt. A fresh adapter obtains no drainable tracking entry until attach verification succeeds; retaining the marker alone does not read or adopt the surviving pipe. Refusal and backoff skip drain/capture and leave evidence unknown (`crates/daemon/src/pane_observer.rs:339-408`).

Fresh-adapter detach rejects foreign markers. A failed existing detach returns before clearing ownership, tracking or sink files. Tracked detach's trust in its local map predates this change; no stronger external-marker guarantee is claimed.

## Repair and digest

The repair text is logged, not executed. Its sink is adapter-derived and POSIX-single-quoted with embedded apostrophes escaped. Pane targets come from tmux-listed IDs and fresh target lookups, not pane titles or PR content. Launches retain discrete argv. No reachable shell/path injection found.

PA refusals are intersected with the digest's scoped fleet rows (`crates/daemon/src/pa_watchdog.rs:944-995,1327-1344`). The normal refusal names the pane and expected daemon sink, not foreign output, pipe argv or credentials. No C19/C21 prohibited disclosure found. C32 was applied to additions only.

Local and GitHub heads agree; worktree clean; PR CLEAN and ready; all five checks succeeded. CI [42421180718](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42421180718) checked synthetic merge `94af97074656fa498ce6e5a3bd6b630a152f2fc6`, whose tree equals this head. Rust reports 2,171 passing cases, five skipped.

JUnit lists passing controls for failed-adoption marker preservation, unmarked/mismatched foreign refusal, foreign detach/file preservation, matching-marker adoption, observer backoff, scoped PA digest and retired launch sites. Tmux fixtures can early-return when tmux is unavailable, so JUnit status alone does not independently establish each body executed. Replacement failure uses simulated exit 71, not the original signal failure; no dedicated failed-detach or hostile-sink repair regression was identified.

No local tests/builds, dependency installs, credentials, live panes, process census, production operations, mutations or imported-main implementation re-review.
